```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load data
# Load data
```{r}
league_raw <- readr::read_csv("data/laser_league_players.csv")
```

## Remove duplicates
```{r}
league_dedup <- league_raw %>% distinct(player_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## Clean columns & missing values
```{r}
league_clean <- league_dedup %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    squad_id = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_to_upper(squad_id)),
    preferred_loadout = if_else(is.na(preferred_loadout) | preferred_loadout == "", "Unknown Loadout", preferred_loadout),
    favorite_drink = stringr::str_to_title(favorite_drink)
  )
```

## Impute scores
```{r}
score_imputed <- league_clean %>%
  group_by(squad_name) %>%
  mutate(season_score = if_else(
    is.na(season_score),
    median(season_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    season_score
  )) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Summary
```{r}
arena_summary <- score_imputed %>%
  group_by(home_arena) %>%
  summarise(
    players = n(),
    avg_accuracy = mean(tag_accuracy_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
arena_summary
```
